Build the goal programming problem

Source: R/build_lp.R
build_lp.Rd

Builds the constraints shared by every priority level,

Usage

build_lp(inputs, g, floor = NULL, ceiling = NULL)

Arguments

inputs

List with D (k x n account coefficients) and B (I - A), for instance a lexio_io object.

g

Goal vector (k + n), for instance from build_goals().

floor, ceiling

Corridor proportions (n, NA = no bound) or NULL.

Value

Object of class lexio_lp: a list with G, the constraint matrix A, dir, rhs, bounds (ROI V_bound) and the indices idx_x, idx_d_plus, idx_d_min.

Details

$$G x + d^- - d^+ = g, \qquad G = \begin{bmatrix} D \\ I - A \end{bmatrix},$$

with the decision variables in the order x_1..x_n, d_1^+..d_m^+, d_1^-..d_m^- (all >= 0, m = k + n), and, when declared, the corridor on the economic goals (the rows of I - A): d_h^- <= alpha_h^floor |g_h| and d_h^+ <= alpha_h^ceiling |g_h| (Rocha, 2026, eq. 4.38). A side that is NULL or NA in a sector has no bound there; with both sides NULL the model is free. Satellite rows never have a corridor.

The rows of the constraint matrix are, in this order: the m goals, then, for each economic row, the bound on d^- and the bound on d^+. The locks of the levels already solved are added by solve_lexicographic().
